description:
FILED s543q (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, CODE 6a1301ed = MAIN-READY-114 + records, v2-16500) by the Rosetta census B (docs/rosetta-plan.md section 6b; #2104).

THE SHAPE (neutral reproducer, run on the tree, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):

    our $g = 1;
    sub f { $_[0] ? (local $g = 2) : 0; return $g }
    print f(1), " ", $g, "\n";

    perl: 2 1
    PCL : PCL: refused statement at ... line 2: ... -- local in this expression position is not supported (#3370)
          (the die at the statement, exit 255)

    The program's spelling (a glob alias in the false arm) is refused the same way:
    our @p; sub area { $#_ > 0 ? @p = @_ : (local *p = shift); ... }

WHERE: Parser2's local-term lowering (`_lower_local_terms`): `_split_void_local_list` takes the void comma list and ruling 3's
`COND and/or (LIST)` spellings, `_hoist_local_term` the first-evaluated term; a local in a `?:` arm is neither, and
`_local_value_consumed` says its value is consumed (the arm is the statement's value), so it is refused instead of announced
(#3414 is the announced, VOID-position residue -- `(local $_, my $x) = @_` -- and is not this).  A void-context ternary whose arm
is a `local` is the `if (C) { local ... }` shape with perl's scope rule: the localization lasts to the end of the ENCLOSING
block (the sub here), not the arm.

CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (taken): 1259 with the line rewritten `local *p; if ($#_ > 0) { @p = @_ } else { *p = shift }`
(the same scope) is byte-identical to perl -- its only cause.

PROGRAMS: 1259-Shoelace-formula-for-polygonal-area.
frequency_reason: Rosetta: 1259-Shoelace-formula-for-polygonal-area (`$#_ > 0 ? @p = @_ : (local *p = shift);` -- alias the argument array or copy the list)
subject: DROP: a `local` in a TERNARY ARM of a void statement is refused -- `C ? (local $g = 2) : 0;` and `$#_ > 0 ? @p = @_ : (local *p = shift);` die "local in this expression position is not supported (#3370)" at the statement; #3370 is closed and its rulings split `COND and (LIST)` / `COND or local ...`, not `?:` (Rosetta 1259)
triage_reason: `local` in a conditional expression is core language (perlsub: local is an expression), IN by docs/supported-subset.md section 3
